review_targets.name: Candidate Statement Review
review_targets.requirement: Confirm LTC-001 states only restricted-local Pi_A persistence and does not imply global continuation persistence.

review_targets.name: Proof Segment Review
review_targets.requirement: Review RLP-001 through RLP-005 for admissibility ordering, operator typing, and restricted scope preservation.

review_targets.name: Boundary Condition Review
review_targets.requirement: Confirm all required boundary conditions remain declared, satisfied, and locally scoped.

review_targets.name: Failure Geometry Review
review_targets.requirement: Verify all blockers, counterexamples, and excluded domains remain attached and unresolved.

review_targets.name: Composition Review
review_targets.requirement: Confirm LAW034 contributes only local composition support and does not imply global compositional closure.

review_targets.name: Promotion Risk Review
review_targets.requirement: Detect and block theorem proof, universal idempotence, or physics correspondence language.

review_decision_classes.meaning: Candidate passes restricted-local TS4 review only.
Candidate is structurally coherent for local review, but blockers remain active.
Candidate requires revision due to unclear boundary, typing, composition, or lineage conditions.
Candidate fails restricted-local review due to scope breach, blocker collapse, or governance violation.
